seed_derivation: seed = numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([1, j, k, 1])).integers(0, 2**64, dtype=uint64); input_seed the same with s = 2; j = kernel index (K1=1 .. K5=5), k = 0-based case index within the kernel in this file's order
normal_rule: normal i of a set = set[i mod len(set)]
